claims.summary: Introduces the concept of 'ver' (to see/watch) and the traditional formal regency of 'assistir'.
Mentions the direct construction 'assistir o filme' being common in Brazilian Portuguese.

claims.sectionKey: Con a + o/a, se forman las contracciones ao/à

claims.sectionKey: La regencia cambia con otros sentidos de assistir
claims.summary: Discusses the change in regency when 'assistir' has other meanings, such as providing assistance.

claims.sectionKey: Por eso es necesario identificar primero qué significa el verbo en la oración
claims.summary: Emphasizes the importance of identifying the meaning of the verb in the sentence first.
